description: This file contains API client functions for fetching governance-related data, including estate health metrics, system information, risk summaries, dependency maps, evaluation histories, amendments, and impact simulations. It primarily exports asynchronous functions that interact with a REST API using Axios, providing a clean interface for frontend components to consume backend data.
